g.text: Entry points
Core
Static assets
External
index.html · about page: nav, landing overlay, 8 prefetch links
html/portfolio.html · six project cards, 44 prefetch links to pages and jpgs
html/<project>.html · six galleries, flat lists of img tags with fixed sizes
html/contact.html · email, phone and socials as plain text, no form
index.js · the only script here: rAF plus a 1 s hold, then a 4 s crossfade
logo_has_loaded · inline handler copies a hidden img into the circle background
style.css · reset, two base64 @font-face blocks, eight min-width breakpoints
lib/all.js · imagesLoaded 4.1.3 and Masonry 4.2.0 concatenated, local init appended
masonry init · grid, sizer, gutter; a second instance is created on imagesLoaded
dead guard · if (getWidth >= 460) never calls getWidth, so that branch does nothing
img/ · 760 px wide jpgs, no srcset, no lazy loading, prefetched instead
fonts/ · gothic ttf and woff files, unused because the CSS inlines the fonts
style.min.css and inlined-fonts.css · no page references them
root thescaffoldgarden.html · stale copy, base href /frank-2/
manifest, favicons, robots, sitemap · Pages plumbing
GitHub Pages · d3nd3.github.io/frank-2, plain files, no server side
Instagram, Twitter/X, LinkedIn · footer links, the only outbound calls
browser · no API, no analytics, no cookies, no contact endpoint
